The '''Vobati''' were a little-known [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that were [[Homeworld|native]] to [[Vobes]]. [[Valwid Ined]] was a member of this species.

==History==
The Vobati [[Homeworld|hailed]] from [[Vobes]]. Besides this little information was known about them.<ref name="Alien Archive" />

==Vobati in the galaxy==
A brilliant Vobati named [[Valwid Ined]] worked as a [[Forger (profession)|forger]] on the [[moon]] of [[Jedha]] during the [[Imperial Era|Imperial reign]].<ref name="Visual Guide" />
